title: Address translation basics
objectives: Identify the page number and offset components of any virtual address
Explain the purpose of the page table in virtual-to-physical translation

blocks.text: Every virtual address generated by a process is split into two fields: a page number (the upper bits) and an offset (the lower bits). The size of the offset field is determined by the page size — for example, 12 bits for 4 KiB pages. The page number is used as an index into the page table, which returns a physical frame number. The physical address is then formed by combining the frame number with the offset.
